title: handle_authenticate_data catch-all skips authenticate_finish
description: In crates/imap/src/session/auth.rs, the handle_authenticate_data catch-all arm (AuthProgress::None or unexpected state with a non-Cancel data event) logs a warning and returns None but never calls server.authenticate_finish(). If imap-next Server requires authenticate_finish to exit the authenticating sub-state, the session is left stuck: subsequent non-auth commands will be misinterpreted as authenticate data, and the client cannot recover without reconnecting.
